I mean, you can hardly believe otherwise when you know that their mozz box player studied under the same mozz legend, Rem Yonka, as the Sozzenels' Xornu flux&mdash;I mean, Plox.|Ssorku, on Hova Mensk and the Blurtones|<ref name="HI">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020117a_horningin&c=rpg|text=Horning In|int=Horning In}}</ref>}}
'''Rem Yonka''' was a [[mozz box]] player of high repute. The mozz box player of the band [[Hova Mensk and the Blurtones]] and [[Xornu Plox]] of [[the Sozzenels]] both studied under Yonka.
